designNotes:
Created 2026-09-30 from this regular's cast entry in canon/scenes/rest--the-roof.json. Everything about who they are and what they want is that entry's own; only the physical description and the ancestry are new.

ANCESTRY, chosen by Claude under Ingram's 2026-09-30 goal (any ancestry is allowed): Human ('Humans are known for their ability to adapt and thrive in the most challenging situations.' -- ancestry-catalogue.json): one of Golarion's own peoples, so no disguise is needed.

PORTRAIT: See the asset registry note for sayo: image 3: chart and pencil in one hand, a finger raised to a star. Character-portrait template, --ar 2:3, stylize 200, gouache and watercolour anime illustration on a flat teal-grey wall, warm orange golden-hour light across the face.

VOICE NOTES: forced catchphrases in this regular's tics and sample lines were rewritten as habits and manner (tools/art-review/ledger.json has each before and after).

Her or his real statblock is still a placeholder in the scene file (Proposed for Sayo Iwamura: level 1, a candidate, non-combat. Made with Ingram once the NPC generator exists.); not carried here.
